description: This file defines a readonly struct 'GenericGrainInterfaceType' that models a parameterized grain interface type in Orleans, providing methods for parsing, constructing, and retrieving information about generic grain interface types.

classes.name: GenericGrainInterfaceType
classes.description: A readonly struct representing a generic grain interface type with methods for parsing, constructing, and retrieving type arguments.

methods.name: TryParse
methods.description: Tries to parse a GrainInterfaceType into a GenericGrainInterfaceType, returning true if successful.

methods.name: GetGenericGrainType
methods.description: Returns a non-constructed version of this generic grain interface type.

methods.name: Construct
methods.description: Constructs a generic grain interface type with specified type arguments.

methods.name: GetArguments
methods.description: Retrieves the type arguments used to construct this generic grain interface type.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the underlying GrainInterfaceType.
